name: design-os-studio
description: Native GPU-accelerated interface design studio in Rust. Opens and saves Figma .fig files, runs your agent CLI in an Agents panel, and ships a 36-tool MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Native GPU-accelerated interface design studio in Rust that opens and saves Figma .fig files, with a 36-tool MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Open and save Figma .fig files, large kits included, with no CPU use while the canvas is idle. Run Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Antigravity or Gemini CLI in the Agents panel on the open file, read spec packages in the Spec Reader, generate Dev Mode code in 8 languages, and capture headless GPU screenshots for visual QA.
defaultPrompt: Apply your-screen.spec.json (any NodeSpec JSON you or your agent write) onto the canvas, export a verified Figma .fig binary archive, and capture a 1600x1000 GPU screenshot.
Open the 11-stage PRODUCT:OS Spec Driven v2 Reader and verify all User Stories, Gherkin scenarios, and g1..g5 verification gates.
Inspect the selected frame in Dev Mode, generate React and SwiftUI code, and resolve all open canvas pin-comments.
